title: Observation of critical topological phase transition
abstract: Phase transitions are traditionally understood within two seemingly incompatible theoretical paradigms. Landau–Ginzburg phase transitions1,2 are continuous, occurring at critical points where microscopic details become irrelevant and universal behaviour emerges, driven by gapless fluctuations with scale-invariant correlations3. By contrast, topological phase transitions connect gapped phases characterized by quantized topological invariants4,5 and, in doing so, necessarily pass through gapless phase boundaries where such invariants become ill-defined6–9. Here using an acoustic metamaterial platform, we experimentally demonstrate a unifying scenario—a critical topological phase transition—in which topology becomes well-defined at criticality10–13, overcoming this conventional incompatibility, and reorganizes critical behaviour by driving a phase transition along critical phase boundaries14. This transition gives rise to a topology-enforced multicritical point at an isolated intersection of critical boundaries with distinct topology. Along these boundaries, we observe topological edge states and diagnose criticality by means of logarithmic entanglement-entropy scaling15–17. At the multicritical point, the entanglement entropy shows additive logarithmic scaling given by the sum of contributions from adjacent boundaries, directly evidencing topology-enforced multicriticality. These findings establish a hierarchical organization of phase transitions, in which topology shapes criticality beyond the conventional Landau–Ginzburg paradigm and standard topological phase transitions. Using an acoustic metamaterial platform, a critical topological phase transition is experimentally demonstrated establishing a hierarchical phase transition organization, in which topology shapes criticality beyond the conventional Landau–Ginzburg paradigm and standard topological phase transitions.
abstract_zh: 相变传统上在两种看似不相容的理论范式中理解。兰道-金斯堡相变1,2 是连续的，在临界点发生，此时微观细节变得无关紧要，并涌现出普遍行为，由无能隙波动和尺度不变的相关性驱动。相反，拓扑相变连接由量子拓扑不变量刻画的有能隙相4,5，并必然穿过临界相边界，在这些边界中此类不变量变得无法定义6–9。在此，利用声子晶体平台，我们实验性地演示了一个统一的情景——拓扑相变临界点——在此，拓扑在临界点变得有定义10–13，克服了这种传统不相容性，并通过沿临界相边界驱动相变来重组临界行为。此相变在临界边界的孤立交叉点处形成了一个受拓扑强制的多重临界点。在这些边界上，我们观察到拓扑边缘态，并通过对数纠缠熵缩放15–17 来诊断临界点。在多重临界点，纠缠熵表现出由相邻边界贡献之和组成的加性对数缩放，直接证据表明受拓扑强制的多重临界性。这些发现确立了相变的层次组织，在此中，拓扑在兰道-金斯堡范式和标准拓扑相变之外塑造了临界行为。
